description: Довідник КП "Новомосковськ водоканал" is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Комунальне підприємство "Новомосковськ водоканал" Дніпропетровської області. Довідник КП "Новомосковськ водоканал". Coverage: Комунальне підприємство "Новомосковськ водоканал" Дніпропетровської області. The publisher named on the listing is Комунальне підприємство "Новомосковськ водоканал" Дніпропетровської області. Its keywords include керівництво. The listing shows 2 download or service links in XLS. The listing shows 2021-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
